notes: TestToken mints 1,000,000,000 TEST with 18 decimals once to msg.sender (the launch factory) in its constructor. Ordinary transfers and transferFrom burn 1% of the amount, rounded down in minor units, and deliver the remainder to the recipient. Transfers sent by the factory, transfers sent by this launch's registered distributor, and transfers into the Uniswap v4 PoolManager are exempt and move the full amount. Transfers out of the PoolManager are not exempt: a buy delivers 99% of what the pool pays out, so the burn cannot be avoided by routing through the manager's flash accounting. The distributor is resolved at transfer time through factory.distributorOf(launchNumber) with a fixed gas stipend; a factory that reverts or has no distributor recorded is treated as no distributor. There is no owner, additional minting or administrative control. No application contracts or initialization calls are required. pool.initialPrice records provenance only; the deployer derives the opening price from economics.initialMarketCapWei and totalSupply.
